 Notes 
 Buffalo has earned at least one point in four straight home matchups with Columbus (3-0-1).
 In his last 10 games, Zach Benson has registered 13 points (2+11). Benson is riding a five-game point streak (2+6) and he would earn the longest point streak of his career with a point in tonight's game. Benson has recorded at least one assist in three consecutive games and an assist tonight would give him his second four-game assist streak of the season (Oct. 12 to 17; 0+5).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tage Thompson has registered nine points (5+4) in his last four games. A point tonight would mark his 17th point streak of five or more games in his career, and his first since his 11-game point streak from Jan. 31 to March 8, 2026 (6+9). Thompson is two assists away from 200 assists in his career.
 Jack Quinn has recorded 12 points (6+6) in his last 10 games, including three points (2+1) in his last three contests.
 Peyton Krebs has tallied four points (1+3) in his last three games. Krebs' eight points (1+7) are the most he has recorded through the first 15 games of a season in his career.
 Rasmus Dahlin has registered five assists in his last five games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In his last three starts, Colten Ellis has made 80 saves on 88 shots (.909).
